external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organisation using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and views the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, which serves invoice and payment pages, accesses tenant data, and submits render jobs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The billing app loads invoices by invoice number. The source does not state whether it checks company ownership or rechecks roles on requests.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The console is reachable only from the support office network.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The billing app applies the company filter; the database has no row-level security. The source does not state how the database is reached or protected at rest.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.notes: The source does not state how the queue is reached or protected at rest.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared cloud bucket containing rendered PDFs addressed by company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
data_stores.notes: The source does not state how the bucket is reached or protected at rest.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: Customer user uses the billing app, including viewing and editing invoices.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; second factor: none
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, payout bank details, and session information

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: Payer follows an invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: read-write invoices
data_flows.description: Billing app reads and writes tenant database records.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, and recorded user actions

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: Billing app puts a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: PDF renderer reads the invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The source does not state how the renderer reaches the database.

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: PDF renderer writes a PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: Billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies

data_flows.name: sign in console
data_flows.description: Support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: Admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user
data_flows.notes: Subsequent actions are recorded against the customer user rather than the agent.

trust_boundaries.name: customer tenant
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant zone associated with a customer company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The render queue is confidential because its jobs contain company IDs and invoice numbers associated with invoices.
assumptions.basis: The source states that render jobs carry a company ID and an invoice number.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores rendered invoice PDFs.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the renderer writes invoice PDFs to the bucket.

assumptions.assumption: The billing app processes confidential data because it handles invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the billing app as handling invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF renderer processes confidential data because it reads invoices and writes invoice PDFs.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the renderer reads invoices and writes PDFs.

assumptions.assumption: The admin console processes confidential data because it opens billing-app sessions as customer users and records customer-user actions.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the console can open sessions as customer users.
